mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin(username, password, email, create_time, status, face_filename) VALUES(#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{createTime}, #{status}, #{faceFilename})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, create_time as createTime, status, face_filename as faceFilename FROM admin WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password, email, create_time as createTime, status, face_filename as faceFilename FROM admin WHERE id = #{id}
